items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 (widely available) and Mythos 5.2 (restricted via verification programs) as its most capable models for technical work in coding, finance, and sciences. Pricing is $8/$40 per million tokens (20% below 5.1 versions), with up to 30% faster outputs and optional fast mode; prerelease testing included formalizing Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours and solving open physics problems.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2（廣泛可用）與 Mythos 5.2（透過驗證計畫受限），作為技術工作中最有能力的模型，涵蓋編碼、金融與科學。定價為每百萬 tokens $8/$40（較 5.1 版本低 20%），輸出速度提升達 30%，並有可選快速模式；預發布測試包括 30 小時內形式化費馬最後定理與解決開放物理問題。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dual release continues Anthropic’s pattern of tiered access for high-capability models with stronger safeguards on the open version. Early enterprise uptake and independent coding benchmarks will test if it sustains an edge over GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 Carbon on long-horizon agent tasks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雙版本發布延續 Anthropic 對高能力模型的分級存取模式，公開版本有更強保障。早期企業採用與獨立編碼基準將測試其在長時程代理任務上是否維持對 GPT-6 Astra 與 Gemini 4 Carbon 的優勢。
items_flat.quote: We’ve upgraded Claude Fable and Claude Mythos—models that are designed to tackle the most daunting technical challenges.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們升級了 Claude Fable 與 Claude Mythos——設計用來應對最艱鉅技術挑戰的模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for secure agent purchases
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet 供代理安全購物
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, allowing dots (agents) to complete web purchases for US ChatGPT Pro users aged 18+ without accessing real card details. Each transaction requires biometric approval (e.g., Face ID), built with Amex, Mastercard, and Visa; users retain card rewards and dispute protections, with initial rollout limited to Pro subscribers.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，讓 dots（代理）為美國 18 歲以上 ChatGPT Pro 用戶完成網頁購物，而不接觸真實卡號。每筆交易需生物識別批准（如 Face ID），與 Amex、Mastercard、Visa 合作；用戶保留卡獎勵與爭議保護，初期限 Pro 訂閱者。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agents from recommendation to actual commerce with strong user controls and network-token isolation. Early US Pro-only rollout and biometric friction will test adoption before broader expansion.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將代理從推薦推進至實際商務，具備強力用戶控制與網路令牌隔離。早期僅限美國 Pro 的推出與生物識別摩擦將測試採用情況，之後再擴展。
items_flat.quote: Now your dot can securely complete purchases on your behalf—with your approval.
items_flat.quote_zh: 現在你的 dot 可以在你批准下安全地代你完成購物。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday agentic work
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 用於日常代理工作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Hydrogen as a fast, efficient model for coding and agentic workflows, priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens flat across 1M context. It is rolling out to the Gemini API, AI Studio, Search, and paid Antigravity, aiming to replace prior Flash-tier models for high-volume tasks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，作為快速高效模型，用於編碼與代理工作流程，定價每百萬 tokens 統一 $1.50/$7.50，跨 1M 上下文。正推出至 Gemini API、AI Studio、Search 與付費 Antigravity，旨在取代先前 Flash 級模型處理高量任務。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen fills the high-volume/speed tier below Carbon and Argon, aiming to make Gemini 4 widely usable. Independent benchmarks will determine if the claimed speed and quality edge holds against Haiku 5.5 and open models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen 填補 Carbon 與 Argon 以下的高量/速度層級，旨在讓 Gemini 4 廣泛可用。獨立基準將決定其聲稱的速度與品質優勢是否優於 Haiku 5.5 與開源模型。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將尖端智慧帶給所有人——為日常程式設計與代理工作流提供速度與效率。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow targeting up to ~$1.4T valuation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 IPO 路演，目標估值最高約 1.4 兆美元
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed Class A common stock IPO on Nasdaq under the symbol ANT. The offering prices shares at $70–$78, with expected pricing around November 18 and trading around November 19, plus a concurrent private placement; reports indicate multiple-times oversubscription including ~6x demand.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 啟動其擬議 Class A 普通股 IPO 路演，於 Nasdaq 以 ANT 代號。發行價 $70–$78，預計 11 月 18 日定價、19 日交易，並有並行私募；報導顯示多倍超額認購，包括約 6 倍需求。
items_flat.analysis_en: The roadshow tests public-market appetite for frontier AI after the SpaceX listing. Reported oversubscription supports the upper end of the range, but final pricing and aftermarket performance remain uncertain amid valuation scrutiny.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 路演測試 SpaceX 上市後公眾市場對前沿 AI 的胃口。報導的超額認購支持價格區間上端，但最終定價與上市後表現在估值審視下仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日 Anthropic, PBC 啟動其擬議 Class A 普通股首次公開發行路演。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches science blog with GPT-6 Astra lattice Standard Model work
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出科學部落格，GPT-6 Astra 協助晶格標準模型工作
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI launched its science blog on November 15 to share AI-assisted scientific work. The first guest post by physicist Nathaniel Craig describes how he worked with GPT-6 Astra on a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model, turning an idea into a detailed proof contribution.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 15 日推出科學部落格，分享 AI 協助的科學工作。首篇客座文章由物理學家 Nathaniel Craig 撰寫，描述他如何與 GPT-6 Astra 合作，發展標準模型的候選非微擾晶格定義，將想法轉為詳細證明貢獻。
items_flat.analysis_en: This documents a concrete case of frontier models contributing to mathematical physics proofs rather than just writing assistance. Practical simulations and independent acceptance of the result will determine its scientific impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這記錄了前沿模型對數學物理證明的具體貢獻，而非僅寫作協助。實用模擬與結果的獨立接受將決定其科學影響。
items_flat.quote: Physicist Nathaniel Craig shares how he worked with GPT-6 Astra to develop a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 物理學家 Nathaniel Craig 分享他如何與 GPT-6 Astra 合作，發展標準模型的候選晶格定義。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, its smallest efficient model for agent tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Ember，其最小高效模型用於代理任務
items_flat.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs introduced Muse Ember, a low-cost model ($0.10/$0.50 per million tokens) designed for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API with 1M context and multimodal understanding, positioned to pair with larger Muse models.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 推出 Muse Ember，低成本模型（每百萬 tokens $0.10/$0.50），設計用於高量代理工作如工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與長文件解析。可於 Meta Model API 使用，具備 1M 上下文與多模態理解，定位與較大 Muse 模型配對。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ember targets the cheap worker role that pairs with larger frontier models. Cost leadership claims need independent verification against Haiku 5.5, Luna, and open models before it reshapes agent economics.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Ember 瞄準與較大前沿模型配對的廉價工作者角色。成本領先宣稱需獨立驗證，對比 Haiku 5.5、Luna 與開源模型，之後才能重塑代理經濟。
items_flat.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日我們推出 Muse Ember，我們最小且最有效率的模型，為複雜推理執行與日常代理工作而建。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic rolls out Claude Meetings beta for Google Meet
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Meetings 測試版用於 Google Meet
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic began rolling out Claude Meetings in beta on Team and Enterprise plans. Claude joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant that follows the conversation, answers questions, takes notes, and builds docs or whiteboards in real time; expansion to other platforms is planned.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 開始在 Team 與 Enterprise 方案推出 Claude Meetings 測試版。Claude 以可見參與者加入 Google Meet 通話，跟隨對話、回答問題、做筆記，並即時建立文件或白板；計畫擴展至其他平台。
items_flat.analysis_en: The feature shifts Claude from post-meeting summarizer to in-meeting collaborator, limited for now to Google Meet and paid business plans. Adoption will depend on reliability of live participation and privacy controls.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此功能將 Claude 從會後摘要者轉為會議中協作者，目前限於 Google Meet 與付費商業方案。採用將取決於即時參與可靠性與隱私控制。
items_flat.quote: Claude can now join your video calls as a visible participant, follow the conversation and start on work during the meeting.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude現在可以可見參與者身分加入你的視訊通話，跟隨對話並在會議進行時開始工作。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI partners with LVMH Media Division for ChatGPT Enterprise
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與 LVMH 媒體部門合作推出 ChatGPT Enterprise
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a strategic partnership with LVMH Group’s Media Division (including Les Echos, Le Parisien, Paris Match). It deploys ChatGPT Enterprise and tools across media teams for journalism support, while enhancing LVMH content presence in ChatGPT with sourced summaries and links.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布與 LVMH 集團媒體部門（包括 Les Echos、Le Parisien、Paris Match）戰略合作。為媒體團隊部署 ChatGPT Enterprise 與工具以支援新聞工作，同時強化 LVMH 內容在 ChatGPT 中的存在，提供有來源摘要與連結。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal extends OpenAI’s enterprise push into European media while LVMH already runs a multi-model internal platform. It tests whether exclusive tool access and content integration can offset prior diversification to rivals.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易將 OpenAI 的企業推廣延伸至歐洲媒體，而 LVMH 已運行多模型內部平台。它測試獨家工具存取與內容整合能否抵消先前對競爭對手的分散。
items_flat.quote: LVMH Group’s Media Division and OpenAI announce the signing of a strategic agreement to support new uses of artificial intelligence across all the division’s publications.
items_flat.quote_zh: LVMH 集團媒體部門與 OpenAI 宣布簽署戰略協議，支援部門所有出版品的人工智慧新用途。

items_flat.title_en: Jensen Huang discusses potential return as Nvidia CEO amid support campaign
items_flat.title_zh: Jensen Huang 討論可能重返 Nvidia CEO 職位，獲支持活動
items_flat.summary_en: Reports indicate former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has discussed a possible comeback with confidants after his recent resignation. Allies including Elon Musk back a petition with over 160,000 signatures urging the board to reinstate him pending investigation; Nvidia has not confirmed any talks.
items_flat.summary_zh: 報導指出前 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 在近期辭職後，已與親信討論可能重返。盟友包括 Elon Musk 支持超過 16 萬人簽名的請願，敦促董事會在調查期間恢復其職位；Nvidia 尚未確認任何談判。
items_flat.analysis_en: Leadership uncertainty at the dominant AI chip supplier adds near-term risk to supply commitments and investor sentiment ahead of earnings. Any return would still face board and regulatory hurdles tied to the circumstances of his departure.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 主導 AI 晶片供應商的領導層不確定性，在財報前為供應承諾與投資人情緒增添近期風險。任何重返仍將面臨與離職情況相關的董事會與監管障礙。

google.analysis_zh: Hydrogen 填補 Carbon 與 Argon 以下的高量/速度層級，旨在讓 Gemini 4 廣泛可用。獨立基準將決定其聲稱的速度與品質優勢是否優於 Haiku 5.5 與開源模型。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將尖端智慧帶給所有人——為日常程式設計與代理工作流提供速度與效率。

meta.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, its smallest efficient model for agent tasks
meta.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Ember，其最小高效模型用於代理任務
meta.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs introduced Muse Ember, a low-cost model ($0.10/$0.50 per million tokens) designed for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API with 1M context and multimodal understanding, positioned to pair with larger Muse models.
meta.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 推出 Muse Ember，低成本模型（每百萬 tokens $0.10/$0.50），設計用於高量代理工作如工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與長文件解析。可於 Meta Model API 使用，具備 1M 上下文與多模態理解，定位與較大 Muse 模型配對。
meta.analysis_en: Ember targets the cheap worker role that pairs with larger frontier models. Cost leadership claims need independent verification against Haiku 5.5, Luna, and open models before it reshapes agent economics.
meta.analysis_zh: Ember 瞄準與較大前沿模型配對的廉價工作者角色。成本領先宣稱需獨立驗證，對比 Haiku 5.5、Luna 與開源模型，之後才能重塑代理經濟。
meta.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.
meta.quote_zh: 今日我們推出 Muse Ember，我們最小且最有效率的模型，為複雜推理執行與日常代理工作而建。

frontier_other.title_en: Jensen Huang discusses potential return as Nvidia CEO amid support campaign
frontier_other.title_zh: Jensen Huang 討論可能重返 Nvidia CEO 職位，獲支持活動
frontier_other.summary_en: Reports indicate former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has discussed a possible comeback with confidants after his recent resignation. Allies including Elon Musk back a petition with over 160,000 signatures urging the board to reinstate him pending investigation; Nvidia has not confirmed any talks.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 報導指出前 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 在近期辭職後，已與親信討論可能重返。盟友包括 Elon Musk 支持超過 16 萬人簽名的請願，敦促董事會在調查期間恢復其職位；Nvidia 尚未確認任何談判。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Leadership uncertainty at the dominant AI chip supplier adds near-term risk to supply commitments and investor sentiment ahead of earnings. Any return would still face board and regulatory hurdles tied to the circumstances of his departure.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 主導 AI 晶片供應商的領導層不確定性，在財報前為供應承諾與投資人情緒增添近期風險。任何重返仍將面臨與離職情況相關的董事會與監管障礙。

brief_en: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 leads technical work while its IPO roadshow draws strong demand; OpenAI partners with LVMH media and advanced science via GPT-6 Astra; Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen targets agentic speed; Meta's Muse Ember serves cheap agent tasks. No new flagship models today amid Nvidia leadership uncertainty.
brief_zh: Anthropic 的 Fable 5.2 主導技術工作且 IPO 路演需求強勁；OpenAI 與 LVMH 媒體合作並以 GPT-6 Astra 推進科學；Google 的 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 瞄準代理速度；Meta 的 Muse Ember 服務低成本代理任務。今日無新旗艦模型，Nvidia 領導層不確定。
